title: The Writings of Origen, Vol. 1 (De Principiis)
author: Origen (Crombie trans)
description: Origen's On First Principles presents an early Christian attempt to think systematically about God, creation, scripture and spiritual beings. This historical English edition opens a route into both his theological reasoning and its later controversies.
